title: The free energy of the Ising random perceptron
summary: We determine the limiting free energy of the Ising perceptron with independent Gaussian patterns for every bounded Borel log-potential, at every fixed positive temperature and pattern density. We give an explicit variational formula for the limit and prove convergence in expectation and probability.
family_title: Perceptron free energies and microscopic jamming exponents

review.reason: Gives a variational formula for the free energy of the Ising random perceptron.
